Scope: Let a curator review incoming data and accept a complete assessed candidate.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: W01 (bd-01M4W40KKEG53SX6WJ17NQVQSV)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Support project/dataset creation, chosen intake mode, progress, actionable findings and source/mapping context permitted to the user.
2. Show exact candidate/impact and explicit acceptance; resolve existing supported metadata corrections without hidden database edits.
3. Handle resume, cancellation, stale candidates and concurrent correction without discarding accepted colleague changes or presenting partial intake as success.

Verification: Browser/API/PostgreSQL curator journey with interrupted intake, blocked findings and concurrent correction.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/W01.4/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.
